name: Circuit Lab
description: Wire batteries, bulbs, switches, resistors and coils on a 3D board, from closing one gap to Ohm's law, logic gates and circuit diagrams.

about.concept: Systems thinking with electricity: a circuit works only when the loop is closed, and how parts are arranged changes what happens. Series and parallel are seen as dim and bright bulbs before the words are introduced.
about.progression: The ladder starts with dragging one wire into a gap and moves through switches, buzzers, series and parallel bulbs and puzzle houses by 4th grade. The upper rungs add the one-bulb-out test for parallel wiring, conductors and insulators, battery and resistor brightness, Ohm's law on a number pad, voltage and current in series and parallel, AND and OR switch gates, electromagnets, and matching standard circuit diagrams to built circuits by 8th grade.
lifeSkills: Persistence when the first try does not work
